Found 52 items in registries @uicapsule:

Showing items 1-52 of 52:

- voxel-landing (registry:block) - Isometric voxel diorama landing page — scroll pans diagonally through a living world of walkers, marquee signs, and ground-laid typography [@uicapsule] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

  Add command: `[object Promise]`

  Add command: `[object Promise]`

  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- predictive-back (registry:block) - Android's predictive back gesture — drag from the edge and the screen shrinks in your hand, revealing where you'll land before you commit. [@uicapsule]

- drum-picker (registry:block) - The iOS time-picker wheel on the web — 3D cylinder, momentum flicks, detent snapping, edge fog. [@uicapsule]
